findings.evidence: Repo-wide grep for `pbwFiltration_def` and `pbwFiltrationPrevious_def` returns only the two declaration sites (PBW/Basic.lean:81, 99) — no uses. Neither is `@[simp]`, so grep is conclusive. `pbwFiltration_eq_pow` at PBW/Basic.lean:87 and `wordFiltration_eq_pow` at WordFiltration/Basic.lean:61-63 (`:= (rfl)`) give the same equation by transitivity.
findings.fix: Delete both theorems; add a bridging lemma later if and when the PBW associated-graded step actually needs one.
findings.issue: `pbwFiltration_def` (line 81) and `pbwFiltrationPrevious_def` (line 99) are new public `rfl` restatements of the two definitions with no consumer anywhere in the repo, and `pbwFiltration_def` is already available from lemmas in the same file: `(pbwFiltration_eq_pow R L k).trans (TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration_eq_pow _ k).symm`, since `wordFiltration_eq_pow` (TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/Basic.lean:61) is itself `rfl`. `pbwFiltrationPrevious` is likewise already characterized by `pbwFiltrationPrevious_zero`/`pbwFiltrationPrevious_succ` (lines 106, 111). This also contradicts the PR description's "No PBW-specific naming layer is added".

summary: The generic word-filtration associated graded duplicates nothing in Mathlib (no GradedPiece/AssociatedGraded at this pin) and the 475-line Clifford copy is deleted with all consumers rewired. The only defect is two new unused rfl lemmas in PBW/Basic.lean that restate what pbwFiltration_eq_pow already gives.
